_comment: JSON-Schema-SUBSET for build_offer_perf_emit.py's offer-perf-emit.json (BC-12943, ADR-028 Phase-2 Batch B). Validated by scripts/eval/assert_lib.py — supported keywords ONLY: type (name or list; 'null' matches None), required, properties, additionalProperties:false, items, enum, const. This asserts the matrix SHAPE (every row carries the same key set + types). frontmatter/sections/banners/retirement_signal/versions are left type-only ([object|array|boolean, null]) so the golden + golden_compare lock their (per-branch, heterogeneous) values: an OK row carries the projected report; a rejection row (an invalid offer slug → the canonicals guard, exit 1) carries null for every report field + a non-null error string.
